# Phase Two — Exact Files to Touch

> The Awtsmoos is infinite; the diff must be finite. Every file named here has one vessel and one reason to unite.

## First implementation draft

Create under `src/core/universalApi/`:

1. `Awtsmoos.js` — five-verb immutable public facade.
2. `createAwtsmoos.js` — composes authorities from options.
3. `createAwtsmoosAuthorities.js` — builds semantic kernel, Portal, transactional world runtime without duplicating logic.
4. `AwtsmoosExplanation.js` — serializable explanation/provenance/capability view if needed after exact signature inspection.
5. `AwtsmoosPipeline.js` — canonical discoverable pipeline-stage descriptor.
6. Rewrite complete `index.js` — export new facade modules while retaining every existing export.

## Tests after first source draft

Create focused modules, each kept small:

- `test/universalAwtsmoosFacade.test.mjs`
- `test/universalAwtsmoosPlanning.test.mjs`
- `test/universalAwtsmoosCompilation.test.mjs`
- `test/universalAwtsmoosCompatibility.test.mjs`

Only add a file when the behavior requires it; do not pad the release with empty architecture.

## Documentation/examples after behavior verifies

- `docs/UNIVERSAL_AWTSMOOS_API.md`
- `examples/universalAwtsmoosDemo.mjs`
- Full rewrite of an existing index/readme only if a verified discoverability gap remains.

## Potential public demo

Do not choose a route until current Awtsmoos serving/routing and existing procedural demos are inspected. If needed, create an isolated mobile-first route whose files are listed in a later DELTA plan before writing.

## Files explicitly not to rewrite merely for style

- mature procedural-language modules;
- Creation Portal six-verb facade;
- `createUniversalAwtsmoosApi.js` transactional implementation;
- unrelated MitzvahWorld/Piano/Nesher/Android files;
- any other agent’s dirty work.
